entities.summary: Södertörn University is a Swedish public higher education institution located in Flemingsberg, in Huddinge Municipality in Stockholm County. The university serves the Södertörn area in southern Greater Stockholm and has approximately 14,000 students enrolled across around 80 programmes and more than 300 courses.
